baseline.conditions: Two transfer/weather days included; finite scheduled craft.

title: A short flight can take days
daily_life: Ossara and Aurel Quay trade through finite scheduled craft. Their nearby map positions make waiting feel especially unfair, which gives scenes room for comedy and frustration.
timing: 130 km at 100 km/day takes 1.3 movement days. Add two transfer/weather days: 3.3 elapsed days, scheduled as 4 whole day blocks.
handoff: A confirmed seat still depends on the inspected craft, load and weather. An unused booking is not a spare aircraft waiting behind the set.
story_option: A guest learns every stall in the departure court during a delay, then must leave just as they begin to feel at home. The delay creates a relationship, not only an obstacle.
production: The earlier three-day summary stays visible as historical input. Future staging uses four planning blocks unless a documented itinerary changes the assumptions.
direction: Listed a-to-b planning reference; reverse passage requires a fresh itinerary.
geometry: Regional endpoints and route length inherited; connecting line is not a surveyed track.
